scope: Batch 11 extraction from the untagged 2012 Magic 2013 card-story columns (Talrand, Odric, Krenko, Xathrid Gorgon, Stonekiller part 2, Chronomaton) and the Planeswalker's Guide to Avacyn Restored part 2. Claims are as of each 2012 page; leadership is not present-day canon. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: kalyntri

quotes.quote: Kalyntri had been the natural ruler of this part of the Kapsho seas for over three hundred years.

claims.summary: The dragon Kalyntri had ruled this part of the Kapsho seas for over three hundred years before Talrand arrived.

claims.subject: talrand

quotes.quote: Talrand's proclamations had been very clear that all of the Kapsho was now Talrand's kingdom and all of its denizens under Talrand's control.

claims.summary: Talrand proclaimed all of the Kapsho his kingdom (a claim, contested by Kalyntri).

quotes.quote: But worst to Kalyntri were those drakes who had given up all pretense of freedom, such as those who now served the upstart Talrand.

claims.subject: talrand

quotes.quote: Talrand was merely gone, and only the problem of him, and his drakes, remained.

claims.summary: Talrand and his drakes are Kalyntri's problem and rival for rule of the Kapsho.
claims.limitation: Rivalry is inferred from Kalyntri's point of view across the story; the quote states the 'problem', not the word rival.

claims.subject: odric

quotes.quote: Sir Odric, Master Tactician, Commander of the Gavony Riders and Recipient of the Moonsilver Accommodation didn't startle easily.

claims.summary: Sir Odric is Commander of the Gavony Riders (Magic 2013 story, 2012).

claims.subject: grete

quotes.quote: He glanced across the oak table at Grete, his lieutenant, who looked surprised by his sudden movement.

claims.limitation: The quote's 'he/his' refers to Odric from the surrounding narration.

claims.subject: feather

quotes.quote: And no one noticed a snaggletooth goblin enter the chambers of Vinrenn, aka Feather, the guildmaster who apparently lacked control.

claims.summary: Feather (Vinrenn) was the Boros guildmaster at the time of this 2012 story; the 2013 Gatecrash guide calls her the previous, disgraced guildmaster.

claims.subject: sentos

quotes.quote: An hour to the east is An Karras, the city of my birth.

claims.summary: The narrator Sentos was born in An Karras.
claims.limitation: The narrator is identified as Sentos elsewhere in the story ('East of the border, I am called Sentos the Merciful.').

claims.subject: thune

quotes.quote: But today, we're putting the scope on the mountains at the border of Thune in Shandalar.

claims.summary: Thune is a region of Shandalar.

claims.subject: nira

quotes.quote: Except for Nira, the ragged band of Sunstrikers had already disappeared into the trees.

claims.summary: Nira belongs to the ragged band of Sunstrikers.
claims.limitation: Membership is inferred from 'except for Nira, the ... band ... had disappeared' and her 'We're Sunstrikers' line.

claims.subject: bazzle

quotes.quote: Yes, this was by far his greatest creation.

claims.summary: The inventor Bazzle built the Chronomaton, his greatest creation.
claims.limitation: 'his' refers to Bazzle and 'this' to the Chronomaton named by the adjoining card art caption.

claims.subject: einolf_brandt

quotes.quote: The compound includes a large manor where Captain Einolf Brandt lives with his wife and family.
Brandt is a loyal, competent leader and an excellent equestrian.

claims.summary: Captain Einolf Brandt leads the Gavony Riders (Avacyn Restored guide, 2012); compare Odric as 'Commander' in the M13 story.
claims.limitation: The guide describes Brandt under the Gavony Riders heading at Rider's Lock; 'captain of the Riders' is not one sentence.

claims.subject: lewenhart

quotes.quote: The head of this mastery is a strict, clever man named Lewenhart.

claims.summary: Lewenhart heads the Mausoleum Guards mastery of the cathars.

claims.subject: roricus

quotes.quote: The leader of this group is a former moor chaplain named Roricus

claims.summary: Roricus, a former moor chaplain, leads the rogue Diabolists who hunt devils.

claims.subject: kolman

quotes.quote: Kolman, the town elder, successfully uncovered a small group of families giving refuge to some suspected werewolves.

claims.summary: Kolman is the town elder of Gatstaf, who led werewolf purges.

claims.subject: garruk_wildspeaker

quotes.quote: Garruk had been hunting Liliana across multiple planes in order to force her to remove the curse

claims.summary: Garruk hunted Liliana across planes to make her lift the Chain Veil's curse.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

quotes.quote: In their first encounter, she inflicted him with the Chain Veil's curse

claims.summary: Liliana cursed Garruk with the Chain Veil.

remaining: Talrand, Odric, Krenko, Xathrid, Stonekiller 2, Chronomaton and AVR guide part 2 are targeted, not exhaustive. Krenko 2012-07-18 is a duplicate of 2012-07-16. Threadbare and A Blessed Life are registered as reviewed without a claim.
